source_quality_scale.4: official primary source or official catalogue; current legal duty, reporting route, operational method, service definition or safety control verified
source_quality_scale.3: official source with a material dynamic-state, future-version, general-guidance, case-specific, surveillance, assumption or scope caveat

quality_guards: Food hygiene ratings are establishment-specific, locally maintained and dynamic; they are not food-quality scores.
Food crime, poor hygiene, consumer-order disputes and food incidents use different reporting routes.
Recall and allergy-alert evidence is product-, batch- and time-specific.
KCSIE 2025 remains operative through 31 August 2026; the 2026 edition is not promoted before 1 September 2026.
School security guidance is not an exhaustive threat catalogue and requires current local intelligence.
Education emergency and outbreak controls depend on the incident, affected group and health-protection advice.
Smoke, carbon-monoxide and electrical duties are tenancy and building controls rather than direct risk measurements.
The smoke and carbon-monoxide booklet is non-statutory general guidance, not a substitute for the regulations.
Pre-2000 asbestos age is an assumption trigger rather than confirmation that a material contains asbestos.
Uninspected asbestos survey areas remain presumed and are not silently treated as clear.
Domestic Legionella systems may be low risk only under the described operating conditions; no generic certificate is inferred.
Routine domestic Legionella sampling is not promoted where HSE says it is usually unnecessary.
NOIDs publication changes and pauses are kept separate from ongoing operational public-health response.
Notifiable-disease counts reflect surveillance and reporting processes, not local infection probability.
Navigational warnings and MSI broadcasts are dynamic voyage-time information and may be interrupted by rescue operations.
Food, school, housing, asbestos, infection and maritime evidence is not converted into exact parcel-level probability.
Current official-source verification does not replace 130-candidate/16-endpoint live parity, browser DOM/console acceptance, commit ancestry, publisher push or remote readback.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
